sentences.s: We have science class on Monday.
sentences.sCn: 我们星期一有科学课。

sentences.s: Tuesday is my art lesson day.
sentences.sCn: 星期二是我的美术课日。

sentences.s: Wednesday is in the middle of week.
sentences.sCn: 星期三是一周的中间一天。

sentences.s: We play basketball on Thursday.
sentences.sCn: 我们星期四打篮球。

sentences.s: Friday afternoon is so relaxing.
sentences.sCn: 星期五下午真是轻松惬意。

sentences.s: I visit my grandparents on Saturday.
sentences.sCn: 我星期六去看望爷爷奶奶。

sentences.s: Sunday is a good day for family picnic.
sentences.sCn: 星期日非常适合全家野餐。

sentences.s: Have a wonderful weekend!
sentences.sCn: 周末愉快！

sentences.s: Spring is green and lively.
sentences.sCn: 春天生机勃勃一片翠绿。

sentences.s: We swim happily in hot summer.
sentences.sCn: 在炎热的夏天我们快乐地游泳。

sentences.s: Golden leaves fall in cool autumn.
sentences.sCn: 金黄的落叶在凉爽的秋天飘落。

sentences.s: Snowflakes dance in white winter.
sentences.sCn: 雪花在洁白的冬日漫天飞舞。

sentences.s: Which season do you like best?
sentences.sCn: 你最喜欢哪个季节？

sentences.s: I help mum clean the room.
sentences.sCn: 我帮妈妈打扫房间。

sentences.s: Dad cooks delicious dinner for us.
sentences.sCn: 爸爸为我们做美味的晚饭。

sentences.s: I can wash my own clothes.
sentences.sCn: 我自己会洗自己的衣服啦。

sentences.s: A stone bridge spans over the river.
sentences.sCn: 一座石桥横跨在小河上。

sentences.s: Many birds live in the green forest.
sentences.sCn: 许多鸟儿生活在绿色的森林里。

sentences.s: Clean water flows in the gentle river.
sentences.sCn: 清澈的河水在温柔的小河中流淌。

sentences.s: Climb up the mountain to see sunrise.
sentences.sCn: 登上高山看日出。
